title: The Killer Cows
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Cows are more dangerous.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel.
Cows now share a hive mind and are suspicious of players. They will stare at you constantly. If you kill a cow, the others will know; they will either flee from you or, if provoked enough, coordinate a mass attack against you.
